sections.section_title: LTDC layer x pixel format configuration register (LTDC_LxPFCR)
sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.30 "LTDC layer x pixel format configuration register (LTDC_LxPFCR)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2138.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x11C + 0x100 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x00000000
This register defines the pixel format that is used for the stored data in the frame buffer of
alayer. The pixel data is read from the frame buffer and then transformed to the internal
format 8888 (ARGB). When components are provided with less than 8bits per component,
they get expanded to 8 bits by replication of their MSB onto their LSB.
When the Alpha value is not defined in the input pixel format, Alpha is assumed for farther
needs to be equal to 255 (opaque layer).
Bits 31:3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 2:0 PF[2:0]: Pixel format
This bitfield configures the pixel format.
000: ARGB8888 (32bpp)
001: ABGR8888 (32bpp)
010: RGBA8888 (32bpp)
011: BGRA8888 (32bpp)
100: RGB565 (16bpp, A=255)
101: BGR565 (16bpp, A=255)
110: RGB888 (24bpp packed, A=255)
111: Flexible pixel format selected (see Section43.7.46 and Section43.7.47)
